description: This file defines the REST API resource for managing groups in the Fineract system. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, listing groups, retrieving group details (with associations), creating, updating, deleting, activating, and other group-related operations, as well as fetching account summaries and importing/exporting group templates.

classes.name: GroupsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing group operations in the Fineract system, handling HTTP requests related to group templates, listing, details, creation, updates, deletion, activation, association management, account retrievals, and template uploads/downloads.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch a group template, optionally for a specific center or office, including handling 'close' command to retrieve closure reasons.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all groups with support for pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch details of a specific group by ID, with optional associations like client members, roles, calendars, etc.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new group based on the provided JSON payload.

methods.name: unassignLoanOfficer
methods.description: Handles POST request to unassign a staff member from a group.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update details of a specific group.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a group if it is in pending state and has no associations.

methods.name: activateOrGenerateCollectionSheet
methods.description: Handles POST request for multiple commands such as activating the group, associating/disassociating clients, generating/saving collection sheets, unassigning/assigning staff, roles, and closing the group, based on the 'command' query parameter.

methods.name: retrieveAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve accounts overview for a group including loans and savings accounts.

methods.name: getGroupsTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET request to download an Excel template for groups.

methods.name: postGroupTemplate
methods.description: Handles POST request to upload a group template Excel file for bulk import.

methods.name: retrieveglimAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve GLIM accounts of a group, optionally filtered by parent account number.

methods.name: retrieveGsimAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve GSIM accounts of a group, with filtering options.
